spans.s: Udraka Rāmaputra (= Pali Uddaka, which also occurs in mss. of Mv, see s.v., Rāmaputta; see also Rudraka), n. of a teacher with whom the Bodhisattva studied for a time: Mv 〔ii.119.8 ff.〕; 〔200.13〕; 〔iii.322.11, 13〕; Mvy 〔3516〕; Udraka (alone), associated with Ārāḍa, q.v., Divy 〔392.1, 3〕; Mv 〔ii.200.8〕; and with Devadatta (as persons of bad conduct), Śikṣ 〔105.17〕. Udraka also Buddhacarita 〔12.84 ff.〕 Tib. lhag spyod (superior conduct) for Udraka (Mvy) and Rudraka (LV 〔243.15 ff.〕).
